composers_checked.name: Gentili, Giorgio
composers_checked.note: Gap check against it.wikipedia's work list: Op. 1 (1701), Op. 2 (1703), Op. 4 (1707) are on IMSLP; Op. 3 Capricci (violin and cello or harpsichord) is a duo; Op. 5 and 6 are concertos for strings. Minutes from the Brilliant Op. 1 cycle.

composers_checked.name: Corbett, William
composers_checked.note: Gap check against en/de Wikipedia: Op. 2 and Op. 4 Libro primo are for two flutes (no string part); Op. 4 Libro secondo (six sonatas for two violins and bass, 1712) and the BIS 'Sonata no. 4' found no confirmed recording; Op. 8 is orchestral.

composers_checked.name: Gallo, Domenico
composers_checked.note: Gap check (en.wikipedia, MusicBrainz, Apple Music): the 12 Sonate a quattro (Concerto Melante, DHM 88875063252) mark solo and tutti, so they are string-orchestra works and stay out; the six violin sonatas are duos. Dates differ (b. 1723 or 1730), so left blank.

composers_checked.name: Krieger, Johann Philipp
composers_checked.note: Gap check against de/en Wikipedia: the two printed sets, Op. 1 (two violins, 1688; added, not on IMSLP) and Op. 2 (violin and gamba, 1693). A 'Sonata à 4' (Lautten Compagney, Prospero 2025 single) has no source or scoring found: not added. Lustige Feld-Music is for winds.

composers_checked.name: Pez, Johann Christoph
composers_checked.note: Gap check against de/en Wikipedia: Op. 1 is Pez's only printed chamber set; the overture-suites and concertos are orchestral. Op. 1 No. 1's key: Apple Music says 'B major', probably B-flat (German 'B'), so the title has no key.

composers_checked.name: Rebel, Jean-Féry
composers_checked.note: Kept the seven trios of the 1712 Recueil (2 violins, bass viol, continuo), titled by name (Beyer numbers L'Apollon 3, La Pallas 5, Tombeau 7; the rest unconfirmed). The five duos: no recording identified. The 1713 'Sonates à violon seul mellées de récits pour la viole' are filed by IMSLP as violin sonatas; the dance symphonies are orchestral.

composers_checked.name: Tibaldi, Giovanni Battista
composers_checked.note: Gap check against de.wikipedia: two Roman sets, Op. 1 (1701, not on IMSLP; the nine recorded sonatas added) and Op. 2 (1704). Op. 1 Nos. 5, 8, 11 unrecorded. Keys of Op. 1 from the cpo track list.

note: (1) Floor evidence is the Apple Music catalogue (iTunes Search/Lookup: album, artist, (P) line, track timings) and MusicBrainz; minutes are the sums of those tracks. (2) Continuo convention: 'violoncello col basso per l'organo' (Gentili, Corbett, Tibaldi) is one continuo part as in Corelli's benchmark; Krieger Op. 2, Pez Op. 1 and Rebel's trios have a separate bass-viol (or cello) part, so four parts for Pez and Rebel. (3) Rebel: the 1712 Recueil is 7 trios + 5 duos, all with a separate bass-viol part with récits; the duos (violin, viol, continuo) are in scope but no recording was identified. The trios' numbers in the print are not all confirmed, so titles use the names. Rebel's 1713 'Sonates à violon seul mellées de plusieurs récits pour la viole' (IMSLP: violin, continuo; recorded in part by Amandine Beyer, Zig-Zag 2005) may also be three-part works with an obbligato viol: owner to decide. (4) Krieger Op. 1 and Tibaldi Op. 1 are added from the gap check (not on IMSLP); Krieger's IMSLP 'Trio Sonata in E minor' (Flores Musicae 7) is taken to be Op. 1 No. 2 without a score check. (5) Pez Op. 1 No. 1: key not confirmed (Apple Music 'B major'). Gallo's dates conflict (1723 or 1730 to c. 1768–81). Levels are estimates from style, not graded from scores.
